# Traefik — custom-to-root-context-servlet-mapping

Proxy at /app/ui/, app at root / with VAADIN_URL_MAPPING=/ui/*. Two translations at once: /app/ui/HILLA and /app/ui/connect lose both segments because Hilla lives at the context root, while everything else loses only /app. As in custom-to-root-context, nothing puts the prefix back into a redirect.

Proxy URL on `http://localhost:9090`: `/app/ui/`

## Configuration

See [docker-compose.yml](./docker-compose.yml) for service definitions.

Traefik dynamic config (`vaadin.yml`), mounted into
`/etc/traefik/dynamic`:

```yaml
# Proxy at /app/ui/, app at root / with the Vaadin servlet on /ui/*. Two
# translations at once: the public /app prefix has to come off, and Hilla's
# resources have to come out from under the servlet mapping.
#
# /HILLA/* and /connect/* live at the backend's context root whatever
# vaadin.url-mapping says, while the browser asks for them beneath /app/ui, so
# those two paths lose both segments (vaadin/hilla#289). Everything else only
# loses /app: /app/ui/* stays /ui/* for the Vaadin servlet, including
# /ui/VAADIN/push, and the root-level resources — /VAADIN/*, /sw.js,
# /styles.css, /manifest.webmanifest, /icons/*, /images/* — keep their place.
#
# As in custom-to-root-context, nothing puts the /app prefix back into a
# response: /app/test-redirect answers a Location without it. The cookies
# survive because the backend scopes them to / and a browser at /app/ui/ sends
# cookies set on a parent path.
http:
  routers:
    hilla-push:
      rule: PathPrefix(`/app/ui/HILLA/`)
      entryPoints:
        - web
      priority: 100
      middlewares:
        - strip-app-ui
        - compress
      service: vaadin

    hilla-connect:
      rule: PathPrefix(`/app/ui/connect/`)
      entryPoints:
        - web
      priority: 100
      middlewares:
        - strip-app-ui
        - compress
      service: vaadin

    root:
      rule: PathPrefix(`/app/`) || Path(`/app`)
      entryPoints:
        - web
      priority: 1
      middlewares:
        - strip-app
        - compress
      service: vaadin

  services:
    vaadin:
      loadBalancer:
        servers:
          - url: http://vaadin:8080

  middlewares:
    # Both segments, in one middleware: a prefix list is a set of alternatives,
    # not a chain, so "/app/ui" has to be named as one string.
    strip-app-ui:
      stripPrefix:
        prefixes:
          - "/app/ui"

    strip-app:
      stripPrefix:
        prefixes:
          - "/app"

    compress:
      compress:
        excludedContentTypes:
          - text/event-stream
          - text/plain
```

The entryPoints and the file provider come from the shared
[traefik.yml](../../traefik.yml), mounted read-only.
